coverage_assessment: Twelve captured open-web actions (46 query expressions; 249 ordered headers) and 16 source cards, including 10 documented body reads (two partial) and six search-only leads. English/Korean coverage plus Japanese/Chinese discovery queries; relevant reporting is sparse and partly based on anonymous sources. North Korean domestic media, systematic local archives and LexisNexis were unavailable. No qualifying February protest was established by this research; absence is not inferred. Human/source review, remaining relevant search-only pages, and official-baseline compatibility remain open.
